top_comments.author: @HowardCShawIII
top_comments.text: +1 for laziness. I'll do type-safety for functions, but miss me with that for data mapping to the database. I'll take my runtime where I can add zero lines of code and get a full user interface including parent-child relationships, lookups, sorting, grouping, filtering, printing, building reports by example, etc, just by adding a new table to the database with the correct prefix. Or one line of code for permanent additions. And the same code can run against multiple databases simultaneously that are not all on the same schema version.
